title: Colonizer fleet export bundle
description: The fleet export contract of docs/protocol.md §6.11 (#687): the manifest.json that opens a `colonizer fleet export` bundle at the top level, and the shapes that travel with it or over the fleet-join transfer (#686) under $defs — the ImportedSession lines of history/sessions.jsonl, the Chunk of the resumable transfer, and the per-member ImportCursor the receiver keeps. A bundle is a zstd-compressed tar whose entries are regular files only (never symlinks); export reads an allowlist of the data dir and, of the config dir, only its host_id, so no API token, provider key, Claude credential or colony secret is ever in one, and a session record is exported as the allowlist projection imported_session defines. An importer rejects an unknown format and any version newer than it supports; unknown fields are ignored for forward compatibility, which is why additionalProperties is deliberately left open, as in docs/agent-events.schema.json.

format.description: An importer refuses any other value before it looks at anything else.

version.description: The bundle format's version. An importer rejects a version greater than it supports; version 1 is what docs/protocol.md §6.11 describes.

origin_host.description: The machine the bundle came from. Namespaces every id it carries: a session's id is "<origin_host>:<original_id>", and the import lands under <data_dir>/fleet-imports/<origin_host>/.

origin_name.description: The exporting machine's hostname, for display — the default export file name carries it too (colonizer-export-<origin_name>-<YYYYMMDD>.tar.zst).

created_at.description: RFC 3339, when the bundle was written.

categories.description: One entry per category, exactly the preview shown before anything is sent (fleet export --preview, and the join flow's preview step). An excluded category appears with included false and zeros — distinguishable from an empty one.

files.description: Every non-manifest entry of the bundle, each with its size and sha256. The importer verifies every hash it applies.

host_id.description: A host id or a colony id as exported: one plain component, no path separators.

category.description: One category of the bundle: history (sessions), logs (per-colony event, harness, gateway and transcript files) or stats (the journals and the computed summary).

included.description: false when the category was left out (--no-history and friends): count, from, to and bytes are then all zero/null as zeros.

count.description: Sessions for history; files for logs and stats.

from.description: The earliest created_at across the exported sessions; null when there is none.

to.description: The latest updated_at across the exported sessions; null when there is none.

file_entry.description: One file of the bundle, named relative to the bundle root.

path.description: Bundle-relative: history/, logs/<original_id>/… or stats/…; never absolute, never through ...

sha256.description: Of the file's raw (decompressed) bytes; verified against it at import.

imported_session.description: One line of history/sessions.jsonl: the allowlist projection of a colony's session record, not the record whole. Only the three identity fields are required; everything else is optional and nullable, so an exporter may leave out what its records never held.

id.description: Namespaced "<origin_host>:<original_id>", so ids from many machines cannot collide in one fleet's sessions.json. Re-import replaces by this id.

status.description: The session status as exported, e.g. pr_opened, merged, closed, no_changes, stopped, failed, waiting_for_answer.

model_usage.description: Cumulative tokens per model, as in the turn_end event (docs/agent-events.schema.json).

model_routing.description: The routing record as exported; open, because it follows the routing journal's shape.

boot_timing.description: The boot timings as exported; open.

chunk.description: One piece of one bundle file on the resumable transfer (the join flow's chunks_for → apply_chunk, docs/protocol.md §6.11). offset, raw_len and total count raw (decompressed) bytes; data carries the chunk's raw bytes zstd-compressed and base64-encoded.

offset.description: Raw byte offset of this chunk in the file. Equal to the receiver's committed offset: append. Wholly below it: a duplicate, ignored. Above it: a gap, refused.

total.description: The file's whole raw size, so the receiver knows what is left.

data.description: The chunk's raw bytes, zstd-compressed, base64-encoded.

import_cursor.description: The receiver's per-member progress, kept at <data_dir>/fleet-imports/<origin_host>/cursor.json: the member's origin_host, when the cursor was last touched, and one files entry per path in flight. A resumed transfer starts from the committed offset; if re-sending a file's first offset bytes no longer hashes to prefix_sha256 — the source rotated or rewrote the file mid-transfer — the file restarts from 0.

origin_host.description: The member this cursor belongs to; empty while a caller drives apply_chunk directly, without a bundle's manifest.

updated_at.description: When a chunk last landed; null until the first one does.

offset.description: Raw bytes committed for this file so far.

prefix_sha256.description: Sha256 of those committed bytes, so a changed source is detected before more of it is appended.

model_tokens.description: Cumulative tokens one model spent, the same shape the turn_end event carries (docs/agent-events.schema.json).
